answer_1.quote: We develop an approach to generate extractive summaries of novel chapters.

answer_2.quote: Summary quality is evaluated on F1 scores for R-{1,2,L}, and METEOR.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation to assess which system is best at content selection. We use a lightweight, sampling based approach for pyramid analysis that relies on crowd-sourcing...
answer_4.guideline: We ask the crowd workers to indicate which of the sampled reference summary content units are conveyed in the generated summary.
